title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Exhibition Hall on 1968-12-21
lineage: SBD cassette master > cassette > DAT/0 > CDR/0 > CDR/1 > iMac > SHN

ai_review.summary: Low‑level, slightly hissy soundboard captures a fiery 1968 set highlighted by the Alligator > Caution jam and intense early‑’69‑style improvisations.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its high energy and classic ’68 freak‑out vibe, with standout moments like the Alligator→Caution sequence, The Eleven jam, Feedback/“Bid You Goodnight,” and a Pigpen cameo. Although the recording suffers from low volume and noticeable hiss, listeners find it acceptable and enjoy the fire in the band’s playing.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.1; most comments highlight an exciting performance while noting consistent low‑level, hissy soundboard issues that are deemed acceptable for a 1968 tape.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low overall levels and noticeable hiss; occasional degraded sections but clear enough to follow the music. No major drop‑outs, just a vintage tape sound that many fans accept.

standout_songs: Pigpen cameo on "Around With Your Good‑byes"
show_quality.setlist_flow: Fast‑paced, intense set that bridges the late‑’68 psychedelic style into early ’69 improvisational intensity; seamless segues keep momentum high.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His guitar work and vocal presence are noted throughout, especially on the WBYG lyrics and jam sections.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as "full of fire"; highlighted in the Caution jam and remembered visually dressing as a preacher at the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: A brief Weir appearance toward the end (sing‑along on Bye Bye) is mentioned, though not a major focus.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum outro after "Bye Bye" is highlighted; drums drive the intense segues such as Alligator→drums→The Eleven.
